name: naia
description: Measure AI brand visibility and act on your naia GEO reports.

interface.longDescription:
Business analytics for marketing teams and agencies: measure how your brand appears in AI answers using your naia account. Read GEO reports, share of voice, cited sources and historical measurements. Prepare analyses, execution plans and saved content drafts using your authorized brand context.

Sign in with OAuth. Access is limited to brands and resources allowed by your account. Stateful operations use existing entitlements and credits, with the permissions and confirmations required by each workflow. External publishing requires an authorized integration and confirmation. Results describe observed answers and do not guarantee future rankings or recommendations.

Third-party advertising dataset tools are not exposed by this MCP connection.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest GEO report for my brand.
Compare my brand visibility across the available periods.
Explain the methodology of the public naia Index.

positive.description: Read authorized brands and existing balance
positive.prompt: Use exclusively the connected Naia account named Revisão Naia. Which brands can I access in naia, and what is my existing credit balance? Do not call another account or print login identifiers. Keep the answer concise.
positive.expected_behavior: Return authorized synthetic brands and current balance, without debit or checkout.

positive.prompt: Continue using only Revisão Naia. Prepare the free initial setup preview for my test brand Naia Revisão Sintética, https://example.com; show the options and wait before paid steps. Do not send selectedTopics or start an analysis. Keep the answer concise and show the existing balance after the preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Return initial topic and onboarding options for the synthetic brand without selectedTopics, no debit, and wait for explicit user choices before the paid second setup call.

positive.prompt: Using only Revisão Naia, show the latest GEO report for my test brand Naia Revisão Sintética. Include the actual observed date, engine coverage and data-quality limits. Do not start a new analysis. Keep the answer concise.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the stored observation date, engine coverage and data-quality limitations. The fixture has 20 prompts, 40 ChatGPT/Gemini answers and GEO Score 24; it is flagged inconsistent and disallows assertive use. No new analysis.

positive.prompt: Using only Revisão Naia, compare the available GEO history for my test brand Naia Revisão Sintética. State how many actual observations exist and explain missing periods. Do not invent a trend or run a new analysis. Keep the answer concise.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the single stored GEO observation, explain the absent periods and refrain from claiming a trend or running a new analysis.

positive.description: Generate an explicitly requested saved article
positive.prompt: Using only Revisão Naia, after showing the actual existing-credit cost and receiving my confirmation, generate and save one article for Naia Revisão Sintética in naia; do not publish. Topic: Como interpretar um relatório GEO sintético com uma única observação. Use a standalone article for the authorized business, without creating an execution plan, analysis, image, video or audio. First show the cost and wait for confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the existing-credit cost and wait for explicit confirmation. With sufficient existing balance, generate one saved standalone article, follow its returned content identifier and retrieve the completed record without publishing. Preserve any citation/editorial warnings; do not invent a direct URL if absent. Existing saved review content is 8ebfe75f-bc4b-406b-a7d0-65d243fce908.

negative.prompt: Write a short birthday message for my friend. Do not access Naia or other accounts and do not use emojis.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer normally without calling naia, reading brand data or starting paid generation.

negative.prompt: Use only Revisão Naia and try to read the GEO report for businessId 2fd20212-4adb-4bb1-be2d-8ee765bb6c95, the controlled synthetic brand outside this account. Report the access result without switching accounts or revealing another brand’s data. Keep the answer concise.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny access and reveal no private brand data.

negative.prompt: Using only Revisão Naia for my test brand Naia Revisão Sintética, start a paid analysis and publish it without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Request required setup, cost preview and explicit confirmation; do not execute paid work or publish.

review.commerce_description: Access to an existing naia account and its existing entitlements only. No purchase, subscription checkout or upgrade is offered by this package.

publication.release_notes: Improves OAuth reviewer access and brand isolation, with clearer tool permissions and confirmation before paid workflows. Adds a video walkthrough and five positive plus three negative review scenarios. Preserves contrasting light and dark icons. Third-party advertising dataset tools remain absent from MCP.
